hooks.text: 1至6人分工驾驶、炮塔、抢修、充能、造弹，并出舱修船或搜刮残骸
hooks.excerpt: Pilot the ship, man the turrets, perform emergency repairs, recharge the power cells, utilize space station weaponry, fabricate munitions and exit the ship on extravehicular missions - be it patching the ship hull or scavenging derelict wrecks.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 弹性船员职责与随时安装的舰船系统，让队伍在航行中快速换战术
hooks.excerpt: Your ship, your way to play: With a flexible player role system and on-the-go installable ship systems you’ll be able to switch your strategies faster than a rogue asteroid changes course.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 赢下太空战后搜刮珍贵材料，用战利品升级飞船以应对更恶劣环境
hooks.excerpt: The victor claims the spoils, and you’ll need to scavenge valuable materials to upgrade and face the direst conditions with top notch equipment … and don’t forget to go full fashion victim and customize your character's spacesuit to fly in style and boldly go where you probably shouldn’t have!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
